description: Wastewater Inlet - Hourly Flow - Eastern Treatment Plant (ETP) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Corporation. The Eastern Treatment Plant (ETP) receives sewage from the eastern side of Melbourne. This file describes the volume of sewage pumped through ETP on an hourly basis.NOTE. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Corporation. Its tags are eastern treatment plant, flowrate, melbourne, sewage, sewerage. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
